title: Entries are shared between applications: the CRM Audit Log lists Desk changes
label: BUG
env: TAVI CRM › Settings › Security Control › Audit Log (ndc-crm.anyware.software/settings/security/audit-log), signed in as ndc-owner
rows: Shown only in the Desk Audit Log. The CRM Audit Log lists CRM actions plus shared account activity (sign-ins, security settings).
The CRM Audit Log shows "ndc-owner updated Desk Administrator's permission ... GRANT desk:ticket:all_departments" and the same for Desk Reviewer (14:49, 14:50).
Shown only in the Desk Audit Log.
The CRM Audit Log shows "ndc-owner updated Tickets' RecordVisibility from hierarchy to public" (14:44), a Desk Tickets setting.
